## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio`, kept in `pm:queue`. ⚠ A cloud pin-pair rule comes with it

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T13:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** the metadata-admin readers in `packages/app-shell` are `domain:ui`, and the area is `area:studio`.
- **Why p1 and `target:v18`:** it is the companion of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2 (p1, `target:v18`), and ruling Q1 A / Q2 A makes them one landing.
- **The order on objectstack's side:** this card merges, then S2 lands with its `.objectui-sha` bump to this merge, as filed. objectstack's console pin stays where it is until S2, so its console is safe.
- **⚠ The install face that is not safe: cloud.**
  - cloud pins objectui itself (`cloud/.objectui-sha`), and its bot bumps that pin alone, about daily ("the framework pin stays"). cloud's framework pin is v17 (`56bf27affb`) until C7 (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709).
  - Once cloud's objectui pin passes this merge while its framework pin lacks #22340 S2, cloud's Studio reads `allowEnvironmentOverlay` from a server that writes `allowOrgOverride`. Every packaged item of the five overlay types then turns read-only, silently. That is this card's own failure mode, on cloud.
  - **So the pin-pair rule:** cloud's `.objectui-sha` may pass this card's merge commit only in the same commit that moves `.objectstack-sha` to a commit carrying #22340 S2. Until then, cloud's objectui-alone bumps stop at this merge's parent.
  - The rule is recorded on objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 in this round. ⛔ No dual read here, as the ruling says.
- **The carried banner remedy** (the read-only banner prescribing a remedy that no longer exists) rides this card, as filed.
- `Clause-②: no` on objectui, which only reads a renamed field.

- **Why not now:** `area:studio` already has one card in flight, seat 2's objectui#12113 (claim `6109802426`), and the two file surfaces intersect.
  - objectui#12113 deletes `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/StudioHomePage.tsx`, one of this card's readers.

  - SKILL.md 〈状态模型〉 `area:*`: 「同轴至多一个在飞,除非文件面不相交」.
- **When:** dispatchable once #12113's PR lands. It is first in this lane's order then (`priority:p1`, `target:v18`).
- **Known pitfalls for that dispatch, measured now on objectui `main` `158c75d`:**
  - **`Clause-②: yes`, not triage's `no`.** `RichMetadataTypeEntry` is published: `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:466` exports it. Renaming its field changes the published surface, so a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue.
  - `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` is on epic objectui#7611's C9 reader list (its `sys_capability` read). The dispatch owes a cross-lane declaration on objectstack-ai/objectstack#15194 before that file is edited.
  - After #12113 lands, `StudioHomePage.tsx` is gone. Re-measure the card's 12-file list on the merged `main` rather than reuse it.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2: read `allowEnvironmentOverlay` everywhere and `allowOrgOverride` nowhere, plus the carried banner remedy, as filed and as triage `6109764647` grades)

- this seat's objectui#12146, dispatched in the same batch, touches `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` and the locale packs, not this surface.
- **Cross-lane:** `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` is on epic objectui#7611's C9 reader list (its `sys_capability` read). This card edits only its `allowOrgOverride` reads. A declaration goes on objectstack-ai/objectstack#15194 in this same act.
- **The order on objectstack's side** (`6112246741`): this card merges first, then objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22874, held as a draft for the pin round) bumps `.objectui-sha` to this merge. ⛔ No dual read of both names.

**Why `Clause-②: yes`, against triage's `no`:** `RichMetadataTypeEntry` is published (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:466` exports it). Renaming its member removes `allowOrgOverride` and adds `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, which changes the published surface. A review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12168 (head `2c38817d0a`) · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-12T00:43Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report (`os-dev-report` `6115575587`). Contract review: **PASS**, PR objectui#12168 comment `6115701744` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `2c38817d0a`).

### Verdict

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`. The first line is `Fixes #12141`, and `Clause-②: yes` sits at a line start.
  - No other card number sits next to a closing keyword.
  - Assignee `os-steve`.
- **Scope:** 74 files, +634/−181. The only content file is `content/docs/guide/console.md`; nothing is under `content/docs/releases/`. `check-governed-merges --pr objectstack-ai/objectui#12168`: NOT governed, 815 changed lines.
- **The rename lands whole:**
  - The eleven readers named in the claim read `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, and 59 test files moved one to one.
  - Nothing reads both names, and no fallback reads the old one. The old key survives only in the changeset's from/to prose, and as history in the pending changesets the claim left alone.
  - The banner and tooltips name `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`, and the registry flip is gone (en and zh).
- **`Clause-②: yes`:** the member moves on `RichMetadataTypeEntry` (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:466`) and on `resolveResourceConfig`'s parameter and return (`:436`), both exported.
  - The changeset is `@object-ui/app-shell` `minor`, with a BREAKING statement and the migration. objectui ships breaking changes as `minor` (`check-changeset-no-major`).
  - The contract review PASS covers this.
- **Deviations, each accepted:**
  - Two new test files (`ResourceEditPage.environmentOverlay-12141.test.tsx`, `DirectoryPage.environmentOverlay-12141.test.tsx`). They carry the card's done-when, each write gate for the five overlay types, with the negative-control type.
  - The in-place fix of `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` and `perm.readOnly.hint` (en and zh). They offered the hatch as a route for a code-package set, which ADR-0131 D6 closes. The two pins moved with them.
  - The banner's statement of the hatch's reach.
  - A probe test that was never committed.
- **Cross-lane:** `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` changes only its overlay-flag reads, as declared on objectstack-ai/objectstack#15194 (`6115259878`).
- **Gates on this head** (read at this record): 39 success, 3 skipped by design, 1 failure.
  - The failure is `Spec Main Shape Gate`, at `previews/flow-node-refs.ts:145`.
  - It is not this PR's: the file is not in its diff.
  - The cause is objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #22883. The anchor card is objectui#12170, claimed and dispatched by this seat.

### Out-of-scope findings

- When the hatch elevates a type, its packaged items still show Edit, and the server refuses the save with 403. Filed as objectui#12169, serial after this PR. The pointer naming both halves of the seam, as the contract review asks, is on that card.
- The Studio landing copy, the console guide row this PR touched, and nearby comments still say "org overlay" / 「组织覆盖」 after ADR-0131 D6 retired that axis. Filed as objectui#12171, serial after this PR.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s type-gate comment cites three stale cross-file line addresses. Carrier: epic objectui#7611 C9, the next PR to touch that comment. The cross-lane declaration keeps this diff to the flag reads.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize`'s refused-save fixture quotes a pre-D6 server sentence. Acceptance notes: it is test-fixture drift, and the assertion is that the client shows the server's words verbatim.

### Acceptance notes

- The contract review notes that the `Clause-②` line has no `(narrowing)` arm, although a member is removed. The objectstack side declared `yes (narrowing)` for the same rename. The level and the BREAKING text are complete, and objectui's declaration gate passed, so the body stays as it is.
- objectui `AGENTS.md` and the dev's own definition set the commit trailers.

**Landing:** waits on objectui#12170. Once it merges, the seat syncs this PR with `main` through the relay. If the PR's own diff is unchanged on the new head and every check is `success` or skipped by design, the seat marks the PR ready and turns on auto-merge through the merge queue. After the merge, objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22874) bumps `.objectui-sha`, as agreed in `6112246741`.
